# Spark Control Center 1.2.2

This patch fixes OIDC auto-provisioning against PostgreSQL when a newly authenticated user does not yet have an explicit namespace assignment.

## Fixes

- Persist a PostgreSQL empty `text[]` instead of SQL `NULL` for new OIDC users with no namespace assignment.
- Normalize all local-user namespace writes at the database boundary.
- Treat a nil namespace query parameter as the documented unrestricted namespace selection instead of PostgreSQL `NULL`.
- Repair legacy nullable `local_users.namespaces` rows during the idempotent startup migration before enforcing the default and `NOT NULL` constraint.
- Exercise the real PostgreSQL migration and OIDC auto-create path in both CI and release workflows.

## Release assets

- `spark-control-center-1.2.2.tar` — frontend image (`spark-control-center:1.2.2`).
- `spark-control-center-backend-1.2.2.tar` — backend image (`spark-control-center-backend:1.2.2`).
- `spark-control-center-1.2.2.tgz` — Helm chart.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for packaged artifacts.

The image names do not contain a private registry prefix.
